Synthesis protocolOrdered operations, material dependencies and stage-specific conditions

01
precursor preparation

Generate lead oleate in situ

Combine PbO, oleic acid and octadecene in a three-neck flask; heat under nitrogen150°C until yellow solid fully dissolves to form Pb oleate.

synthesis

Cool and inject the assigned TOPSe source
